High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner is seeking quashing of FIR on the ground that he has already punished under the provisions of Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and, therefore, he cannot be prosecuted under the provisions of Indian Penal Code.

Learned counsel for the petitioner, in support of his stand, has placed reliance upon a judgment reported in (2024) 3 SCC 502 [Ram Nath vs. The State of Uttar Pradesh and ors.].
Learned counsel for the respondent/State is directed to examine this aspect and address the Court because on this legal point.
Although, learned counsel for the petitioner is seeking interim protection saying that the Court is likely to frame the charge against the petitioner, but it does not make any difference, if prosecution would be done under the provisions of IPC, then under the developed circumstances, the charges, if any, is framed by the Court can also be quashed by this Court.
